label: daily: did go-ethereum ship a stable release

input.question: As of now (the timestamp of this request's pinned Ethereum mainnet head block), did ethereum/go-ethereum publish at least one stable release on its public GitHub Releases page during the previous 24 hours? A stable release has draft=false and prerelease=false and a published_at time in that interval.

definitions.project: Use https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/releases and release published_at timestamps. Exclude drafts and prereleases.
definitions.calendar: The 24 hours ending at the timestamp of the window's closing block. Blocks are used only to fix that time.
definitions.missing: Unavailable historical evidence is not false. Report inability rather than guessing.
